data.narrative:
Poolside is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant, having raised $626M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-stage, same-sector comparables—Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B)—alongside one public comparable (Palantir / PLTR) and eight additional private benchmarks.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $626M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across the three direct comparables produces a $3.2B midpoint, with a range of $2.0B to $5.6B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given direct stage and sector alignment.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $3.7B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around competitive positioning relative to better-capitalized peers like Physical Intelligence. Key variables include differentiation in product capability, go-to-market efficiency relative to the peer set, and the durability of team and IP. Stage-progression suggests downside; peer multiples suggest upside potential. A $2.0B–$3.0B range appears most defensible given the data.
